parts: Create production cutout parts for TATUTRAMA, the living-kite ARMADILLO in reference 1. Reference 2 is approved Carcara paper finish, NOT anatomy. Preserve identity: low squat armadillo, large rounded dome patchwork shell in RED/IVORY/CHARCOAL triangles, structural bamboo ribs crisscrossing the shell tied with visible cord knots, small red tassels on shell-side knots, one tiny stitched paper repair; ivory long tapered ARMADILLO snout with dark tiny nose and two small upright narrow ears, small matte dark eyes. Four stubby charcoal feet with digging claws. Long segmented folded-paper ribbon tail in red/ivory/charcoal, curled up and back toward left. No separate kite on top: shell IS its kite anatomy, body and shell ONE solid core piece. No fox, no fur mane, no hedgehog spikes, no scales, no tortoise head. THREE QUARTER RIGHT facing, see front and near side, near feet a little larger, far eye subtly smaller and compressed visible if possible. The head points forward/down slightly, low confident standing posture. Same handmade paper-art as approved Carcara: large clear angular paper planes, clean dark ink contour, 2-3 restrained flat color values per material, tiny localized repair, no glossy 3D, no gradients, no glitter or huge anime eyes. Texture discreet, focus silhouette. Produce SEVEN isolated coherent anatomy pieces plus THREE expression variants on a strict THREE COLUMNS FOUR ROWS PORTRAIT sheet. Transparent background, no text or labels, generous margins, no touching or clipped pieces. Row1 col1 shell/body core with no head or limbs or tail, col2 full neutral armadillo head/neck with both small narrow ears, col3 whole curled ribbon tail root at LOWER RIGHT so it attaches to rear and arches up-left. Row2 col1 near front short clawed leg root at upper-left, col2 far front smaller short clawed leg, col3 near hind short leg root at upper-right. Row3 col1 far hind smaller short leg, col2 determined head, col3 hurt head with squeezed eyes. Row4 col1 happy head with closed happy eyes, col2 and col3 EMPTY. Expression heads identical to canonical head in silhouette, ears, snout, size, orientation, nose and mouth; change ONLY eyes and eyebrows. Complete roots on legs/neck for covered overlap and clean animation; no socket holes. Preserve original Tatutrama pattern and anatomy, NOT Capimansa or Guaravento. Every piece retains same three-quarter perspective, lighting and palette.
